saw_lines: Underwear gets replaced when it wears out, and women return to the brand whose pair fit comfortably the first time.
So the sale is won or lost in the ad itself, where a new buyer decides whether comfort is worth a click.
Your 7 of 23 copy ads share one opener, so shoppers meet one message repeated. Keep the body, change the opening line and creative in each, then test two new angles.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Nov 2026
points: Seven of your 23 copy ads open with the same line, “Old favourites. Very nice prices.” Repeated copy makes the feed feel like one ad. Keep the body, change the opening line and creative in each, then test two new angles.

None of your ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to check the claims against. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.

Two of your 23 copy ads are creator posts run from your brand page, so they read as ads to shoppers. Whitelist both from the creator account, then cut three variations of each, keeping the creator voice in every one.

Seven of 23 copy ads open on “Old favourites. Very nice prices”, so the account leans on one line. Test two new angles against it, a comfort story and a gift story. Give each its own opening line and creative.

ads_1: Comfort and gift openers replacing the shared line, tested on bralettes
